title: Autocommit throttle loses its trailing commit, so edits made within 1 s of the previous commit are never sent unless another edit follows
failureClass: lost edit when switching documents shortly after typing
source: Issue 15261 class (repro e2e in PR 15342); gap 12c in 01-context.md
userVisibleEffect: Type a burst, then open another document within about 1 s: the tail of the burst stays in the in-memory buffered document, which is discarded when the pair is torn down; the server never receives it
